description: Redact specified text from a Zendesk ticket comment using the Agent Workspace method. Redaction is irreversible; Agent Workspace and appropriate permissions are required, and comments on closed tickets cannot be redacted.

inputSchema.description: Request model for redacting ticket comments in Zendesk.

text.description: The exact text string to redact from the comment. Required: omitting it would send an empty payload to the redact endpoint and report success without any redaction having happened. The text must match exactly as it appears in the comment.
text.human_parameter_description: The exact text string you want to permanently remove from the comment. The string must match exactly as it appears.
text.title: Text

ticket_comment_id.description: The ID of the ticket comment to redact.
ticket_comment_id.human_parameter_description: The ID of the specific comment within the ticket that you want to redact.
ticket_comment_id.title: Ticket Comment Id

ticket_id.description: The ID of the ticket containing the comment to redact.
ticket_id.human_parameter_description: The ID of the Zendesk ticket that contains the comment you want to redact.
ticket_id.title: Ticket Id

inputSchema.title: CreateCommentRedactionRequest

name: create_comment_redaction

CreateCommentRedactionResponse.description: Response model for the comment redaction action.

message.description: A message describing the result of the redaction operation.
message.title: Message

success.description: Indicates whether the redaction was successful.
success.title: Success
